ينتجعون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِعُونَ (yantajiʕūna) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# يُنْتَجَعُونَ (yuntajaʕūna) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
